title: Pullback $g^*$ along base change
statement:
Let $\mathcal A$ and $g\colon Z\to Y$ be as in [def-sfb-finite-lower-star], with
$b\colon Y_{\mathrm{proét}}\to Z_{\mathrm{proét}}$ the base change functor. The *pullback*

$$
g^*\colon\Sh(Y_{\mathrm{proét}},\mathcal A)\to\Sh(Z_{\mathrm{proét}},\mathcal A),
\qquad g^*F:=\operatorname{sheafify}\bigl(\operatorname{Lan}_{b^{\mathrm{op}}}F\bigr),
$$

is the left Kan extension of the underlying presheaf of $F$ along
$b^{\mathrm{op}}$, followed by sheafification on $Z_{\mathrm{proét}}$.

proof.text:
The small pro-étale sites are essentially small, and a Grothendieck abelian category is
cocomplete, so the pointwise left Kan extension along $b^{\mathrm{op}}$ exists. For the
same reason sheafification exists on $Z_{\mathrm{proét}}$ with values in $\mathcal A$.

lean.statement:
noncomputable def upperStar :
    Sheaf (Scheme.ProEt.topology Y) A ⥤ Sheaf (Scheme.ProEt.topology Z) A
lean.note: Existing source declaration exactly defines the pullback along an arbitrary scheme morphism as the sheafified left Kan extension along the opposite of the base-change functor, for Grothendieck abelian coefficients.
